answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by combining refundable bonds with independent task evidence. Each identity locks collateral, completes unpredictable work, and receives attestations from reviewers outside its trust circle. A tundra quarantine isolates suspicious clusters, while a yarrow record preserves signed contribution history. Reputation grows like a reef only when evidence agrees across time; failed audits slash bonds and make mass fabrication progressively costlier.
